guidanceConsulted.query: accessible navigation landmarks skip links focus management
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential headings (h1-h3), captioned data tables with <th scope>, and keyboard-focusable scroll containers with visible :focus-visible rings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, sequential h1/h2/h3, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, and tabindex='0' role='region' aria-labelledby on .table-wrap with 3px :focus-visible outline.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation layout tables code blocks mobile desktop
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prevent viewport horizontal overflow via logical max-inline-size: 100% and overflow: auto wrappers around wide tables and code blocks, paired with wrapping flex rows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100% with min-width on .compat-table/.scroll-table; relies on shared public/styles.css for pre overflow-x: auto and wrapping lists.

guidanceConsulted.query: typography code blocks dark mode reference docs
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rely on shared semantic light-dark() design tokens so headings, tables, inline code, and pre blocks maintain accessible contrast in both light and dark modes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: uses shared /public/styles.css variables without inline overrides of pre, code, h1, .baseline-browsers, or blockquote.
